title_original: Peraturan Menteri Perindustrian Nomor 35 Tahun 2025 tentang Ketentuan dan Tata Cara Sertifikasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri dan Bobot Manfaat Perusahaan
title_english: Industry Minister Regulation 35/2025 on certification of local content (TKDN) and company benefit weight
summary_english: Replaces the general rules on calculating and certifying TKDN for goods and services. For goods it weights materials at 75%, direct labour at 10% and factory overhead at 15%, and makes certificates valid for five years.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Cross-sector TKDN rule, included because sector rules (solar, EV) rely on it. Press disagrees on which earlier regulations it revokes (Permenperin 16/2011, 46/2022 on small industry); check the closing provisions. Weights and validity from press, not the text.

title_original: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 55 Tahun 2019 tentang Percepatan Program Kendaraan Bermotor Listrik Berbasis Baterai (Battery Electric Vehicle) untuk Transportasi Jalan
title_english: Presidential Regulation 55/2019 on accelerating the battery electric vehicle programme for road transport
summary_english: Framework for battery electric vehicles: sets staged minimum local content (TKDN) for EVs, provides for fiscal and non-fiscal incentives, and covers charging infrastructure and electricity tariffs for charging.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Dates from BPK and setkab.go.id via search; the Kemenkeu JDIH page gives 28-29 March 2019, which conflicts and looks wrong. Check the TKDN schedule in Article 8 as amended.

title_original: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 79 Tahun 2023 tentang Perubahan atas Peraturan Presiden Nomor 55 Tahun 2019 tentang Percepatan Program Kendaraan Bermotor Listrik Berbasis Baterai (Battery Electric Vehicle) untuk Transportasi Jalan
title_english: Presidential Regulation 79/2023 amending Presidential Regulation 55/2019 on battery electric vehicles
summary_english: Postpones the minimum TKDN schedule for EVs and adds import incentives: companies committing to build EVs in Indonesia may import four-wheel BEVs as CBU or CKD with duty and luxury-tax relief until 31 December 2025, subject to a later domestic production commitment.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). The CBU import window ended 2025-12-31 and press reports no extension. pasal.id labels it revoked; no official source confirms that, check JDIH Setkab.

title_original: Peraturan Menteri Perindustrian Nomor 6 Tahun 2022 tentang Spesifikasi, Peta Jalan Pengembangan, dan Ketentuan Penghitungan Nilai Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri Kendaraan Bermotor Listrik Berbasis Baterai (Battery Electric Vehicle)
title_english: Industry Minister Regulation 6/2022 on specifications, development roadmap and TKDN calculation for battery electric vehicles
summary_english: Sets technical specifications for battery EVs, a roadmap for the EV component industry for 2020-2031, and the method for calculating EV local content. It replaced Permenperin 27/2020.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Signed 2022-03-11 (Berita Negara 2022 No. 270) per search; promulgation date not seen, so date_in_force is the year only. Amended by Permenperin 28/2023, which has no row. TKDN targets (40% to 2026, 60% to 2029, 80% from 2030) are from a Kemenperin presentation; check.

title_original: Peraturan Menteri Investasi/Kepala Badan Koordinasi Penanaman Modal Nomor 6 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman dan Tata Kelola Pemberian Insentif Impor dan/atau Penyerahan Kendaraan Bermotor Listrik Berbasis Baterai Roda Empat dalam rangka Percepatan Investasi
title_english: Investment Minister Regulation 6/2023 on import incentives for four-wheel battery EVs to accelerate investment
summary_english: Implements Perpres 79/2023: sets how companies apply for 0% import duty and government-borne luxury tax on CBU and CKD four-wheel BEV imports, the investment criteria, and the commitment to produce in Indonesia (commercial production by 1 January 2026) at the required TKDN.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Signed 2023-12-28, promulgated 2023-12-29 (Berita Negara 2023 No. 1074); DDTC says in force 15 days after promulgation, taken as 2024-01-13. Incentive window ended 2025-12-31, so status set to expired; production commitments may continue, check. Amended by Permen Investasi 1/2024 (signed 2024-11-08, in force 2024-11-27), which has no row.

title_original: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 10 Tahun 2024 tentang Perubahan atas Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 26/PMK.010/2022 tentang Penetapan Sistem Klasifikasi Barang dan Pembebanan Tarif Bea Masuk atas Barang Impor
title_english: Finance Minister Regulation 10/2024 amending PMK 26/2022 on the tariff classification and import duty schedule
summary_english: Inserts Article 4A into the customs tariff regulation, setting a 0% import duty until 31 December 2025 for battery EVs imported under the Perpres 79/2023 programme, conditional on an incentive approval from the Investment Minister. Imports that do not meet the conditions pay the general rate.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Dates and content read from the official Kemenkeu abstract (BN 2024 No. 105). Duty relief ran to 2025-12-31, so status set to expired. PMK 9/2024 (luxury tax borne by government on CBU/CKD EVs, 2024) has no row.

title_original: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 12 Tahun 2025 tentang Pajak Pertambahan Nilai atas Penyerahan Kendaraan Bermotor Listrik Berbasis Baterai Roda Empat Tertentu dan Bus Tertentu yang Ditanggung Pemerintah Tahun Anggaran 2025
title_english: Finance Minister Regulation 12/2025 on government-borne VAT for certain battery electric cars and buses, fiscal year 2025
summary_english: The government bears 10 percentage points of VAT on sales of four-wheel battery EVs and buses with at least 40% local content, for tax periods January to December 2025. It continued the 2024 scheme under PMK 8/2024.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Date (BN 2025 No. 79) from secondary tax sites; the exact Indonesian title is reconstructed from press and must be checked. Coverage of buses with lower TKDN (2024 scheme gave 5% for 20-40%) not confirmed for 2025. PMK 8/2024 (2024 scheme) has no row. Whether a 2026 successor exists was not checked.

title_original: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 10 Tahun 2021 tentang Bidang Usaha Penanaman Modal
title_english: Presidential Regulation 10/2021 on investment business fields (Positive Investment List)
summary_english: Replaces the Negative Investment List (Perpres 44/2016) with a list of priority fields, fields reserved or partnered with cooperatives and small businesses, and fields with foreign-ownership limits or other conditions. All fields not listed are open to foreign investment.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Dates from Kemenkoinfra JDIH (via search). Check the annex entries for power generation and EV/battery manufacturing priority fields.

title_original: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 49 Tahun 2021 tentang Perubahan atas Peraturan Presiden Nomor 10 Tahun 2021 tentang Bidang Usaha Penanaman Modal
title_english: Presidential Regulation 49/2021 amending Presidential Regulation 10/2021 on investment business fields
summary_english: Amends Article 2, Article 6 and the annex of the Positive Investment List; among other changes it closes alcoholic beverage manufacturing to new investment.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Dates from BPK and Kemenkoinfra (via search); the OSS page shows 2021-02-02, which looks wrong. No energy-specific change identified.

title_original: Undang-Undang Nomor 3 Tahun 2020 tentang Perubahan atas Undang-Undang Nomor 4 Tahun 2009 tentang Pertambangan Mineral dan Batubara
title_english: Law 3/2020 amending Law 4/2009 on Mineral and Coal Mining
summary_english: Amends the mining law, including the obligation to process and refine minerals domestically. Article 170A allowed sales abroad of certain processed but unrefined minerals for at most three years, so exports of unrefined bauxite and other ores ended on 10 June 2023.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Legal basis of the June 2023 bauxite export stop (ESDM and press). The nickel ore ban rows ID-PERMEN-ESDM-2018-25 and ID-PERMEN-ESDM-2019-11 already exist in rules.csv and are related. Status amended because press reports a 2025 amendment of the Minerba law (Law 2/2025); confirm and add a row. Kepmen ESDM 89/2023 (smelter-delay fines) has no row.

issuing_body: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM)
title_original: Keputusan Menteri Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral Nomor 296.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2023 tentang Penetapan Jenis Komoditas yang Tergolong dalam Klasifikasi Mineral Kritis
title_english: ESDM Minister Decision 296.K/2023 designating commodities classified as critical minerals
summary_english: Lists 47 mineral commodities, including nickel, cobalt and bauxite, as critical minerals. The list is valid for three years and may be reviewed each year or when needed.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). The task brief cited the number as 296.K/HK.02/...; the official file uses 296.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2023. Date taken as both signing and effect; check the closing clause. The three-year term ends around 2026-09: check for a replacement list. Kepmen 69.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2024 (22 strategic minerals) has no row.

title_original: Nghị định số 111/2015/NĐ-CP về phát triển công nghiệp hỗ trợ
title_english: Decree 111/2015 on development of supporting industries
summary_english: Provides incentives (corporate income tax, import duty, land and credit support) for projects making supporting-industry products on a priority list, which includes components for the automotive, electronics and mechanical industries.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Dates from general knowledge and secondary sites; check on vbpl.vn. Whether the priority list covers EV or solar components specifically was not checked.

title_original: Nghị định số 205/2025/NĐ-CP sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Nghị định số 111/2015/NĐ-CP ngày 03 tháng 11 năm 2015 của Chính phủ về phát triển công nghiệp hỗ trợ
title_english: Decree 205/2025 amending Decree 111/2015 on development of supporting industries
summary_english: Amends the supporting-industry decree, revising support for technology application and transfer (Article 5) and adding Articles 6a-6c with new forms of financial support for supporting-industry enterprises.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Dates from Thư viện Pháp luật and Tạp chí Công Thương. The MOIT page title contains a typo (3-11-2025 for 3-11-2015). A MOIT circular implementing it exists but has no row.

title_original: Nghị định số 10/2022/NĐ-CP quy định về lệ phí trước bạ
title_english: Decree 10/2022 on registration fees
summary_english: Sets registration fees for assets including vehicles. Battery electric cars paid a 0% first registration fee for three years from 1 March 2022, and were to pay 50% of the rate for equivalent petrol or diesel cars for the following two years.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Replaced Decrees 140/2016 and 20/2019. Dates and EV terms from several secondary legal sites.

title_original: Nghị định số 51/2025/NĐ-CP sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Nghị định số 10/2022/NĐ-CP ngày 15 tháng 01 năm 2022 của Chính phủ quy định về lệ phí trước bạ
title_english: Decree 51/2025 amending Decree 10/2022 on registration fees
summary_english: Keeps the first registration fee for battery electric cars at 0% from 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2027, replacing the 50% rate that Decree 10/2022 had set for that period.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Date in force taken as the issue date; check the effectiveness article. One secondary source reports a Decree 202/2026 (2026-06-08) amending Decree 10/2022 and extending EV preferences further; not verified, no row.

title_original: Luật số 03/2022/QH15 sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Luật Đầu tư công, Luật Đầu tư theo phương thức đối tác công tư, Luật Đầu tư, Luật Nhà ở, Luật Đấu thầu, Luật Điện lực, Luật Doanh nghiệp, Luật Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt và Luật Thi hành án dân sự
title_english: Law 03/2022 amending several laws, including the Law on Special Consumption Tax
summary_english: Among other amendments, set lower special consumption tax rates for battery electric cars from 1 March 2022, with a step-up from 1 March 2027 (for passenger cars with 9 seats or fewer, 3% then 11%).
notes: Scouted from desk research (low confidence). Drafted from general knowledge; number, dates and rates must be checked. The same law also amended the Electricity Law, which is out of scope here. The SCT provisions were superseded when Law 66/2025 replaced the 2008 SCT law from 2026-01-01.

title_original: Luật Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt số 66/2025/QH15
title_english: Law 66/2025 on Special Consumption Tax
summary_english: Replaces the 2008 Special Consumption Tax Law. It sets car tax rates by seat count, engine size and technology, with preferential rates for battery electric cars (3% for passenger cars with 9 seats or fewer under the original text, rising later).
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Adoption date: Thư viện Pháp luật says 2025-06-14, another source 2025-06-24; check. Sources differ on when the 3% BEV rate ends in the original text (2027-03-01 per one). Decree 360/2025 implements it (no row).

title_original: Luật số 09/2026/QH16 sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Luật Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt
title_english: Law 09/2026 amending the Law on Special Consumption Tax
summary_english: Amends the 2025 Special Consumption Tax Law; press reports that it keeps preferential rates for battery electric cars with fewer than 24 seats until the end of 2030 (3% for 9 seats or fewer, then 11% from 2031).
notes: Scouted from desk research (low confidence). Number and date from a single search snippet citing consolidated text 111/VBHN-VPQH (2026-05-20); the EV extension is from press (Người Quan Sát, lsvn). Title, effective date and EV provisions all need checking against the official text.

title_original: Quyết định số 876/QĐ-TTg phê duyệt Chương trình hành động về chuyển đổi năng lượng xanh, giảm phát thải khí các-bon và khí mê-tan của ngành giao thông vận tải
title_english: Decision 876/2022 approving the action programme on green energy transition and reduction of carbon and methane emissions in transport
summary_english: Sets targets for road transport to restrict and then stop the production, assembly and import of fossil-fuelled cars and motorcycles from 2040, and for all road motor vehicles to use electricity or green energy by 2050. It assigns ministries to develop charging infrastructure and supporting policies.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Signed by a Deputy Prime Minister on behalf of the Prime Minister. Date in force assumed to be the signing date. MOT Decision 1679/QĐ-BGTVT (2023-12-22) implements it; no row.

title_original: Chỉ thị số 20/CT-TTg về một số nhiệm vụ cấp bách, quyết liệt ngăn chặn, giảm thiểu ô nhiễm môi trường
title_english: Directive 20/2025 on urgent tasks to prevent and reduce environmental pollution
summary_english: Directs Hanoi to ensure no fossil-fuelled motorcycles circulate inside Ring Road 1 from 1 July 2026, to extend restrictions to Ring Roads 1 and 2 from 1 January 2028 and Ring Road 3 by 2030, and to consider higher registration fees for fossil-fuelled vehicles.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Vietnamese title reconstructed from press; check. Content from press. Hanoi's implementing decisions and whether the July 2026 step took effect were not checked.

title_original: Luật Địa chất và khoáng sản số 54/2024/QH15
title_english: Law 54/2024 on Geology and Minerals
summary_english: Replaces the 2010 Minerals Law and governs geological surveys, mineral exploration, mining, mineral processing and mineral finance. It sets the state's policy on mineral exports, giving priority to supplying domestic production.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Source URL is the vbpl.vn attachment found by search, not opened. No express ban on unprocessed mineral exports was found in this law; check the processing and export articles. Decree 193/2025 implements it (no row).

title_original: Luật số 147/2025/QH15 sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Luật Địa chất và khoáng sản
title_english: Law 147/2025 amending the Law on Geology and Minerals
summary_english: Adds Chapter VIIa on rare earths, classifying them as special strategic minerals under strict state control and prohibiting exports of raw rare earth minerals. Press reports it also restricts exports of refined products and limits rare earth activities to state-designated or approved enterprises.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Source is consolidated text 149/VBHN-VPQH (government data portal), not opened. Content partly from Reuters and VnExpress; check the scope of the refined-product restriction. Promulgation order Lệnh 92/2025/L-CTN. Decree 21/2026 implements it (no row).

title_original: Quyết định số 1959/QĐ-BCT về việc áp dụng biện pháp chống bán phá giá chính thức đối với một số sản phẩm thép cán nóng có xuất xứ từ Trung Quốc và chấm dứt điều tra đối với Ấn Độ
title_english: MOIT Decision 1959/2025 imposing final anti-dumping duties on certain hot-rolled steel from China and ending the investigation of India
summary_english: Imposes anti-dumping duties of 23.10% to 27.83%, by producer, on certain hot-rolled steel from China for five years from 6 July 2025, and terminates the investigation of Indian imports. It follows provisional duties under Decision 460/QĐ-BCT (2025-02-21).
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Included as a trade remedy on a steel input used in wind towers and solar mounting; relevance to clean tech is indirect and a reviewer should decide whether to keep it. Vietnamese title reconstructed from press. A first administrative review has been opened (not checked). No Vietnamese trade remedies on solar or battery goods were found.

title_original: Announcement of the Board of Investment No. Sor. 8/2564: Amendment of Investment Promotion Policy for Manufacture of Electric Vehicles
title_english: BOI Announcement Sor. 8/2564 amending the investment promotion policy for manufacture of electric vehicles
summary_english: Replaces the EV terms of BOI Announcement 3/2564 (13 January 2021) with a revised activity 4.24 covering battery electric, plug-in hybrid and hybrid vehicles and BEV platforms, with corporate income tax exemptions tied to investment size and production of key parts in Thailand.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Dates read from the BOI English translation: announced 2021-11-17, effective retroactively from 2021-09-06. Thai title to be added; binding text is Thai. Later BOI announcements may have changed activity 4.24; check.

issuing_body: National Electric Vehicle Policy Committee (EV Board)
title_original: National Electric Vehicle Policy Committee resolution on the EV promotion roadmap (30@30)
title_english: National Electric Vehicle Policy Committee resolution on the EV promotion roadmap (30@30)
summary_english: Sets a target that zero-emission vehicles make up at least 30% of Thailand's vehicle production by 2030, with phased targets for cars, pick-ups, motorcycles, buses and trucks.
notes: Scouted from desk research (low confidence). Source is news (Nation Thailand, 2021). The meeting date is not confirmed: the roadmap was reported in 2021 and ERIA dates specific ZEV targets to a 2023-05-12 meeting. The BOI still cites 30@30 in 2024. Find the EV Board resolution and Thai title.

title_original: Cabinet resolution approving measures to promote the use of electric vehicles (EV 3.0)
title_english: Cabinet resolution approving measures to promote the use of electric vehicles (EV 3.0)
summary_english: Approves 2022-2023 purchase subsidies for battery EVs (up to THB 150,000 per car depending on battery size), excise tax cuts (8% to 2% for cars) and reduced customs duties on imported BEVs, in return for manufacturers committing to build EVs in Thailand to offset imports.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Thai title to be added. Content from press and KPMG. Implemented by an Excise Department notification (2022-03-21 per KPMG) and Ministry of Finance customs notifications; neither has a row. Amended by the 2025-12-09 Cabinet adjustments.

number: unnumbered (Ministry of Finance notification under Section 12 of the Customs Tariff Decree)
title_original: Notification of the Ministry of Finance on customs duty reduction and exemption for completely built-up battery electric vehicles
title_english: Ministry of Finance notification on customs duty reduction and exemption for CBU battery electric vehicles (2024-2025)
summary_english: Extends customs duty relief for CBU battery electric passenger cars with a retail price up to THB 2 million imported from 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2025: a reduction of up to 40 percentage points, or exemption where the applicable rate is 40% or less.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). From a Baker McKenzie alert (published 2023-12-28) and Nation Thailand. Notification number and Thai title not found; search the Royal Gazette. The 2022 notification it follows (expired 2023-12-31) has no row. Relief ended 2025-12-31; no further extension found.

title_original: Notification of the Ministry of Finance on customs duty exemption for major parts of battery electric vehicles
title_english: Ministry of Finance notification exempting import duty on major parts for domestic BEV manufacturing
summary_english: Exempts import duty on nine main parts used to manufacture or assemble battery electric vehicles in Thailand, for imports up to 31 December 2025.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). From Deloitte and Baker McKenzie alerts (secondary). Number, Thai title and the list of nine parts to be checked in the Royal Gazette. Expiry 2025-12-31 per Deloitte; check for an extension.

title_original: Cabinet resolution on measures to promote electric vehicles, phase 2 (EV 3.5), 2024-2027
title_english: Cabinet resolution on measures to promote electric vehicles, phase 2 (EV 3.5), 2024-2027
summary_english: Continues EV support for 2024-2027: purchase subsidies of THB 50,000-100,000 per car in 2024 stepping down in later years, a 2% excise rate for BEV cars, and up to 40% import duty reduction on CBU BEVs in 2024-2025, conditional on manufacturers producing in Thailand to offset imports.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). The EV Board approved the package on 2023-11-01 (BOI press release 119/2566); the Cabinet date 2023-12-19 is from secondary sources, check. Sources differ on the excise schedule; check the Excise Department notification. Amended by the 2025-12-09 Cabinet adjustments.

issuing_body: National Electric Vehicle Policy Committee (EV Board)
title_original: National Electric Vehicle Policy Committee resolution on promoting battery cell manufacturing for electric vehicles and energy storage
title_english: National Electric Vehicle Policy Committee resolution on promoting battery cell manufacturing for electric vehicles and energy storage
summary_english: Approves financial support from the Competitiveness Enhancement Fund for leading battery makers that produce battery cells in Thailand for EVs and, where possible, energy storage, with minimum energy density (150 Wh/kg) and cycle-life criteria. Project proposals are due by the end of 2027.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). BOI press release 20/2567 says the measure needs Cabinet approval; no Cabinet date was found. Per-kWh grant rates (THB 400-800) and a THB 24 billion envelope come from press and conflict on timing (IEA and Global Trade Alert date the subsidy to 2023). date_in_force set to the board date; correct once the Cabinet resolution is found. The same meeting approved tax deductions for buying electric trucks and buses (2x price for domestic, 1.5x for imported, to 2025-12-31), which has no row.

title_original: Announcement of the Board of Investment No. 6/2568: Measure to Promote the Use of Locally Manufactured Parts in Thailand for Electric Vehicle and Electrical Appliance Industries
title_english: BOI Announcement 6/2568 on promoting the use of locally manufactured parts in the EV and electrical appliance industries
summary_english: Grants a 50% corporate income tax reduction for two further years to promoted EV and appliance projects that obtain 'Made in Thailand' certification showing local content of at least 40% (BEVs, e-buses and trucks), 45% (PHEVs) or 15% (EV equipment) of raw material value. Applications are due by the last working day of 2026.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Read from the BOI unofficial English translation; date in force assumed to be the announcement date. Thai title to be added.

title_original: Cabinet resolution adjusting the EV 3 and EV 3.5 measures
title_english: Cabinet resolution adjusting the EV 3 and EV 3.5 measures
summary_english: Changes the production-offset rules of EV 3 and EV 3.5: EVs built for export count 1.5 times towards the offset, with an export deadline of 30 June of the following year, EV 3 participants may complete offsets under EV 3.5, and the period for valuing imported battery cells is extended to 30 June 2026. Subsidies may be suspended for firms that miss conditions.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). From Nation Thailand (2025-12-09) and thailand.go.th; based on an EV Board resolution of 2025-11-25. Sources conflict on the EV 3.5 sales/registration deadline. Thai title to be added.

title_original: An Act Providing for the Development of the Electric Vehicle Industry
title_english: Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act
summary_english: Sets a national framework for electric vehicles: a Comprehensive Roadmap for the EV industry, charging station requirements for buildings and fuel stations, a minimum share of EVs in corporate and government fleets, and fiscal and non-fiscal incentives for EV manufacturing and use.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Lapsed into law on 2022-04-15 without the President's signature (Lawphil, HTTP 200). Effectivity date (after publication) not confirmed; check the Official Gazette.

issuing_body: Department of Energy, with DOTr and DTI
title_original: Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 11697 or the Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act
title_english: Implementing Rules and Regulations of the Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act
summary_english: Details how the EVIDA is applied, including the roles of agencies, charging-station rules, fleet requirements and the process for EV incentives.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Date from the SC E-Library entry and jur.ph (E-Library returned 403 here). Whether it has a DC number, its effectivity date and NARO filing not found. DOE page returned 200 but its content was not parsed.

title_original: Temporarily Modifying the Rates of Import Duty on Electric Vehicles, Parts, and Components under Section 1611 of Republic Act No. 10863
title_english: EO 12/2023 temporarily modifying import duty rates on electric vehicles, parts and components
summary_english: Cuts the MFN import duty on listed battery electric vehicles and some parts and components to zero (1% for some parts) for five years from effectivity. Hybrids were not covered.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Date signed from Lawphil; effectivity 2023-02-20 from press (the order takes effect 30 days after publication). Annex not reviewed.

title_original: Modifying the Nomenclature and Rates of Import Duty on Various Products
title_english: EO 62/2024 modifying the nomenclature and rates of import duty on various products
summary_english: Keeps the reduced EV tariff rates of EO 12 until 2028 and extends zero duty to other battery EVs, hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles, e-motorcycles, e-tricycles, e-bicycles and certain parts. It also changes duties on other products, including rice.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Read on Lawphil. Effectivity is 30 days after publication; publication date not found, so date_in_force is the year only.

title_original: An Act Reforming the Corporate Income Tax and Incentives System (Corporate Recovery and Tax Incentives for Enterprises Act)
title_english: Corporate Recovery and Tax Incentives for Enterprises (CREATE) Act
summary_english: Lowers corporate income tax rates and replaces the tax incentive system with performance-based, time-bound incentives for activities listed in a Strategic Investment Priority Plan, under oversight of the Fiscal Incentives Review Board.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Approved 2021-03-26 per Lawphil. Effectivity date not confirmed (reported as 2021-04-11; check).

title_original: An Act Amending Sections 27, 28, 32, 34, 57, 106, 108, 109, 112, 135, 237-A, 269, 292, 293, 294, 295, 296, 297, 300, 301, 308, 309, 310, and 311, and Adding New Sections 135-A, 295-A, 296-A, and 297-A of the National Internal Revenue Code of 1997, as Amended
title_english: CREATE to Maximize Opportunities for Reinvigorating the Economy (CREATE MORE) Act
summary_english: Amends the CREATE incentive rules, including enhanced deductions, a longer incentive period for some projects and VAT treatment for registered business enterprises.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Lawphil shows approval on 2024-11-08; the public signing ceremony was reported on 2024-11-11. Effectivity date not confirmed.

title_original: Approving the 2022 Strategic Investment Priority Plan
title_english: MO 61/2022 approving the 2022 Strategic Investment Priority Plan
summary_english: Approves the first Strategic Investment Priority Plan under CREATE. Tier II 'green ecosystems' covers EV assembly, EV parts and systems, EV infrastructure and energy-efficient equipment, making them eligible for incentives.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Read on Lawphil. Takes effect 15 days after publication; publication date not found.

title_original: Approving the 2026 Strategic Investment Priority Plan
title_english: MO 47/2026 approving the 2026 Strategic Investment Priority Plan
summary_english: Approves the 2026 Strategic Investment Priority Plan, which lists activities eligible for incentives under CREATE as amended. Its sustainability activities include EV manufacturing, parts and components, EV charging infrastructure, and processing of strategic and critical minerals into higher-value products, including recycling.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Read on Lawphil. Takes effect 15 days after publication; publication date not found. Whether it expressly revokes the 2022 SIPP was not checked; link_basis set to implied by successor.

title_original: Constituting Green Lanes for Strategic Investments
title_english: EO 18/2023 constituting green lanes for strategic investments
summary_english: Sets up a one-stop action centre at the Board of Investments and 'green lanes' in government agencies to speed up permits and licences for strategic investments, including those in the SIPP.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Read on Lawphil. Took effect on publication in the Official Gazette; publication date not found. Many endorsed projects are renewable energy; generic instrument.

title_original: Amending Section 4 of Executive Order No. 79, s. 2012, Institutionalizing and Implementing Reforms in the Philippine Mining Sector
title_english: EO 130/2021 amending EO 79/2012 on mining sector reforms
summary_english: Amends EO 79 (2012) to allow the government to enter into new mineral agreements, ending the moratorium in place since 2012, subject to existing laws and environmental rules.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Title read on Lawphil; the summary of the moratorium change is from general knowledge, check Section 4 as amended. Effectivity date not found.

title_original: An Act Enhancing the Fiscal Regime for the Large-Scale Metallic Mining Industry, Amending for the Purpose Sections 34(B), 287, and the Subjects of Title VI and Chapter VII thereof, and Creating New Sections 151-A, 151-B, 151-C, 151-D, and 287-A, All under Republic Act No. 8424
title_english: Enhanced Fiscal Regime for Large-Scale Metallic Mining Act
summary_english: Sets a uniform fiscal regime for large-scale metallic mining, including a 5% royalty on gross output for operations in mineral reservations and windfall profits taxes. It also refers to support for value-adding activities and downstream industries for strategic metallic ores.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Approved 2025-09-05 per Lawphil (DOF says 2025-09-04). Operative date 2026-02-17 is from a PwC alert; the Act itself takes effect 15 days after publication. Royalty terms from press; check rates outside reservations. Topic fit is loose (fiscal, not a processing mandate).

title_original: Establishing a National Policy Framework for Developing the Critical Minerals Industry and Reorganizing the Mining Industry Coordinating Council for the Purpose
title_english: EO 122/2026 establishing a national policy framework for developing the critical minerals industry
summary_english: Sets a national framework for critical minerals: DENR-MGB issues a Philippine Critical Minerals List, the DTI-BOI promotes value-added processing and downstream industries such as batteries, domestic processors get priority access to ores at market-based prices, and mining application procedures are streamlined under a reorganised Mining Industry Coordinating Council.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). Read on Lawphil. Effectivity date not found. Whether the Critical Minerals List has been issued (due 30 days after effectivity) was not checked. No raw-ore export ban was found.

issuing_body: Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI)
title_original: National Automotive Policy 2020
title_english: National Automotive Policy 2020
summary_english: Sets the policy for the automotive industry, adding Next Generation Vehicles (including energy-efficient and electrified vehicles), Mobility as a Service and Industry 4.0 to the 2014 policy, with the aim of making Malaysia a regional hub for producing such vehicles.
notes: Scouted from desk research (high confidence). No legal force. Launch date from press and law-firm alerts. MITI said in 2025-08 that a mid-term review was being considered.

issuing_body: Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources (KeTSA)
title_original: Kerangka Pelan Transformasi Industri Mineral Negara 2021-2030
title_english: National Mineral Industry Transformation Plan Framework 2021-2030
summary_english: Sets a framework for the mineral industry to 2030 under five pillars: governance and legislation, the mineral value chain, resource inventory and mapping, technology and innovation, and human capital. It targets a mineral industry contribution of RM29 billion to GDP by 2030.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Source is the ministry media statement found by search (not opened). Launch date from IEA and press; the National Mineral Council endorsed it on 2021-02-16. Rare earth specifics not confirmed.

title_original: Low Carbon Mobility Blueprint 2021-2030
title_english: Low Carbon Mobility Blueprint 2021-2030
summary_english: Sets strategies and action plans for low-carbon transport, including a target that EVs (including hybrids and electric motorcycles) reach 15% of total industry volume by 2030 and targets for public charging points.
notes: Scouted from desk research (low confidence). Adoption date unclear: MGTC says completed in 2020 and gazetted in 2021; NST (2021-04) said Cabinet approval was pending. No legal force. The 15% target is now echoed in the NETR (MY-PLAN-2023-NETR in rules.csv).

title_original: Budget 2022: full exemption of import duty, excise duty and sales tax for electric vehicles
title_english: Budget 2022 exemptions of import duty, excise duty, sales tax and road tax for electric vehicles
summary_english: Exempts battery EVs from import and excise duty (fully imported units) and from excise duty and sales tax (locally assembled units), and from road tax. The CBU exemption was extended annually and ended on 31 December 2025; the CKD exemption runs to 31 December 2027.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Budget announcement 2021-10-29; legal basis is exemption orders under the Customs Act and Excise Act whose P.U.(A) numbers were not found. Extensions (Budget 2023 for CKD to 2027-12-31; CBU to 2025-12-31) and the CBU cut-off (units arriving before 2025-12-28) from MITI and MAA via press. Each exemption order needs its own row.

issuing_body: Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI)
title_original: New Industrial Master Plan 2030
title_english: New Industrial Master Plan 2030
summary_english: Sets a mission-based industrial policy to 2030 with four missions, 21 strategies and 62 action plans, targeting manufacturing value added of RM587.5 billion by 2030. It covers EVs, batteries and renewable-energy equipment among priority industries.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). No legal force. Launch date and figures from MIDA and press. The EV/battery/solar coverage is from general knowledge; check the plan text.

title_original: Policy prohibiting the export of raw rare earth elements
title_english: Policy prohibiting the export of raw rare earth elements
summary_english: Prohibits exports of raw (unprocessed) rare earth elements to build domestic processing. NRES said in November 2025 that a moratorium applies for 2025-2027 and will continue in the medium term, with case-by-case exceptions for research and processing.
notes: Scouted from desk research (low confidence). The Prime Minister announced the policy on 2023-09-11 with no start date. One parliamentary report says the moratorium has applied since 2024-01-01; date_in_force is the year only. The legal instrument (e.g. a customs prohibition order) was not found. Press in 2026-08 reported the government might relax the ban.

title_original: Budget 2024: Green Investment Tax Allowance and Green Income Tax Exemption (tiered)
title_english: Budget 2024 revision of the Green Investment Tax Allowance and Green Income Tax Exemption
summary_english: Revises the green technology tax incentives into tiers for applications received from 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2026: for example 100% allowance against 70% of statutory income for battery storage and green buildings and 60% for renewable energy and efficiency projects, and adds green hydrogen and wind. GITA for own-use assets moved to MGTC.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). Budget 2024 tabled 2023-10-13 (date from general knowledge). Rates from MIDA pages. These incentives mostly reward clean-energy deployment rather than manufacturing; the topic fits loosely. Legal basis is Income Tax (Exemption) orders and Schedule 3 rules, not found.

issuing_body: Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry (MITI)
title_original: Revised import policy for completely built-up electric vehicles
title_english: MITI revised import policy for completely built-up electric vehicles
summary_english: From 1 July 2026, new CBU electric vehicles may be imported only if their CIF value is at least RM200,000 and motor output at least 180 kW. It follows the end of the CBU duty exemption on 31 December 2025.
notes: Scouted from desk research (medium confidence). From press reports of a MITI statement of 2026-05-06; the MITI statement itself and its legal basis (approved permit conditions) were not found. MITI said in 2026-07 it would not reverse the rules. Ministry name per 2026 press.
